name: Klarna
summary: Klarna's careers pages describe applying to a pipeline for a competence rather than one job, then an online abstract reasoning test that it says every applicant takes, a recruiter screen, a first round on your skills and examples of Klarna's values (often a coding test for engineers), a second round that goes deeper once a likely team is found, and a final stage meeting future colleagues. Klarna says the process takes roughly four to six weeks from the first chat, and advises reading up on Klarna even if you know the brand.
rounds: Apply to a pipeline for your competence (engineering, design, data and so on)
Recruiter screen on your experience and career interests
First round: role skills and examples of how you've worked; a coding test for many engineering roles
Second round: a deeper look at your skills once a likely team is identified
Final stage: meet future colleagues and discuss terms
looks_for: Reasoning: spotting patterns and solving problems

questions.text: Tell me about a time you moved fast on something and it paid off, or didn't.
covers: How you decided what to skip
The result and what you learned

questions.text: Tell me about a time you owned a problem from start to finish.
Tell me about a time you used customer feedback to change what you built.
Tell me about a decision you had to reverse.
covers: How you handled it with others

questions.text: How would you design a checkout option that lets shoppers pay in instalments?
covers: The flow for the shopper and the shop
Credit and risk checks in real time
Reminders, payments and what happens when one is missed

questions.text: How would you decide in seconds whether to approve a shopper for pay later?
covers: Signals you'd use and which you wouldn't

questions.text: How would you improve the shopping app's home screen for people who rarely open it?
covers: Ideas and a test for each
The metric that tells you it worked

questions.text: Walk me through how you'd approach a coding problem you haven't seen before.
How would you explain buy now, pay later responsibly to a first-time user?
covers: What it is in plain words
Costs and what happens if you miss a payment
Helping them borrow only what they can repay

questions.text: Which competence pipeline are you applying to, and how do your skills fit it?
Why do you want to work at Klarna?
covers: Something specific about Klarna's products or ambition

questions.text: What do you know about Klarna beyond the brand?
covers: Its products for shoppers and shops

tips: Practise abstract reasoning tests before you apply; Klarna says everyone who applies takes one.
Klarna hires into competence pipelines: be clear about your core skill rather than one job title.
Read up on Klarna's products for shoppers and businesses, even if you already use it.
Klarna says replies can be slow because of how many people apply; a referral from an employee can help.
